_note: Exact UN# config — validates Moss retrieval and is the hardcoded demo fallback if retrieval misses. Distances reflect ERG 2024 guidance (rounded for demo).

1005.name: Ammonia, anhydrous
1005.hazards: Toxic and corrosive. Vapors are lighter than air but a cold cloud may hang low. Inhalation causes severe respiratory irritation.
1005.actions: Isolate spill/leak 300 ft in all directions. Stay upwind. Evacuate 1 mile downwind for a large release. Responders need full protective gear and SCBA.

1017.name: Chlorine
1017.hazards: Toxic gas, heavier than air; pools in low areas. Severe respiratory hazard.
1017.actions: Isolate 600 ft. Evacuate up to 3 miles downwind for a large release. Stay upwind and uphill.

1203.name: Gasoline
1203.hazards: Highly flammable. Vapors may travel to an ignition source and flash back.
1203.actions: Eliminate ignition sources. Isolate 150 ft. Evacuate 0.3 mile if a tank is involved in fire.
